_note: Destinations and Phuket beach areas. Descriptions are general travel facts; villa counts are computed from villas.json.

destinations.name: Phuket
destinations.short: Thailand's biggest island: west-coast beaches, sunsets and the widest choice of pool villas.

areas.name: Bang Tao
areas.short: 6 km beach, Laguna resorts, beach clubs and Cherng Talay cafés — the villa capital of Phuket.

areas.name: Layan
areas.short: Quiet bay inside a national park strip, hillside villas with sea views.

areas.name: Surin
areas.short: Small upscale beach between Bang Tao and Kamala, clear water November–April.

areas.name: Kamala
areas.short: Relaxed family beach, cliff-side villas on the road to Patong.

areas.name: Patong
areas.short: The busiest beach and nightlife hub; villas sit on the quieter hills above.

areas.name: Karon
areas.short: Long wide beach with squeaky sand, easy for families and long stays.

areas.name: Kata
areas.short: Lively but laid-back, surf in the green season, cafés and sea-view villas.

areas.name: Kata Noi
areas.short: Small secluded bay next to Kata, one of the island's most beautiful beaches.

areas.name: Nai Harn
areas.short: South-coast favourite of long-stayers: lake, beach, yoga and a calm pace.

areas.name: Rawai
areas.short: Southern tip, seafood market and boats to the islands; popular for monthly rentals.

areas.name: Chalong
areas.short: Marina for yacht and island trips, central for schools and everyday life.

areas.name: Mai Khao & Nai Yang
areas.short: Long quiet beaches in the north, 10 minutes from the airport.

destinations.name: Koh Samui
destinations.short: Palm-fringed island in the Gulf of Thailand with calm seas and hillside villas.

destinations.name: Pattaya
destinations.short: Two hours from Bangkok, open all year, large family houses with pools.

destinations.name: Bangkok
destinations.short: Capital city stays: serviced houses and apartments for monthly living.

destinations.name: Krabi
destinations.short: Limestone cliffs, Ao Nang and Railay, gateway to Phi Phi and the Hong islands.

destinations.name: Koh Phangan
destinations.short: Jungle island next to Samui, quiet bays and a big long-stay community.

destinations.name: Hua Hin
destinations.short: Royal seaside town south of Bangkok, golf and calm family beaches.

destinations.name: Chiang Mai
destinations.short: Northern mountain city, temples and a cool season — popular for monthly stays.
